title: Corrective fix for B-8197dbad-subtask-review: Review Fix RecipesFolderStore .withSecurityScope iOS unavailability
description:
Blocked reason: saveBookmark (RecipesFolderStore.swift:55-68) calls startAccessingSecurityScopedResource() on line 55 but only calls stop on line 61 inside the do body. If url.bookmarkData() throws, the catch block runs clearBookmark() without calling stop — violating Apple's requirement to always balance start with stop. Fix: add `defer { url.stopAccessingSecurityScopedResource() }` immediately after the start call (or after guarding on its return value), and remove the explicit stop on line 61.

Remaining work: Fix resource leak in saveBookmark: stopAccessingSecurityScopedResource() must be called even when bookmarkData() throws (use defer). Optionally guard on the Bool return of startAccessingSecurityScopedResource().
acceptance_criteria: Implement the minimum fix required to unblock B-8197dbad-subtask-review.
Update tests/docs as needed for the corrective change.
Leave a handoff summary that states how the parent bead can be retried.
conflict_risks: None — fix is isolated to saveBookmark in RecipesFolderStore.swift; no other bead claims this file.
